profile.name: m6000-32g
profile.title: Quadro M6000 24 GB with 32 GB of RAM
profile.tested: 2026-11-23 on a VM with 16 EPYC 7742 threads, 31 GiB of RAM and the M6000 at PCIe Gen3 x8, with engine patches 0007-0009 and these settings: speed 40.4 / 46.9 / 32.0 / 39.1 tok/s (chat / code / story / 4K doc), prompts 194 tok/s; balanced 35.7 / 38.2 / 29.7 / 35.1 tok/s, prompts 180 tok/s; GSM8K answers 2% (speed) and 8% (balanced) faster than without the settings; both in low-RAM mode, answer checks passed
notes: IQ3_S (quality) needs about 57 GiB of free RAM and is not offered.
The packs do not fit in RAM: the engine keeps the most used experts in RAM and reads the rest from disk (low-RAM mode), so a fast SSD matters.

Both presets ask for a missed expert's slices together (STRATA_FETCH_WILLNEED, engine patch 0008) and send the look-ahead's read hints for the top three ranks only (STRATA_LOOKAHEAD_K=3): measured, 59% (speed) and 77% (balanced, with its context) less read from the disk, which matters most on a slower SSD.

balanced has a 131,072-token context: the attention cache's RAM copy is sized for the whole limit, and the 1.7 GiB a halved limit frees hold more experts (3.4% faster). For conversations past 128K tokens, set "context": 262144 on it.
Keep other programs light: with IQ3_XXS every GiB they take slows answers down; Q2_0 holds its speed.
A switch takes about 2 minutes: the packs do not stay in the page cache, so each start reads the pack from disk (81-93 s to the first answer, measured from a cold start).

speed.description: Q2_0 pack, 2.4 bits/weight: the fastest, and the best choice with 32 GB of RAM; task average 89.1

balanced.description: IQ3_XXS pack, 3.0 bits/weight: task average 92.6; with 32 GB it slows down as other programs use RAM
